headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger's test indicates no significant funnel plot asymmetry (p=0.5897). The distribution of studies appears symmetric, suggesting a lower risk of publication bias.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 12 studies yielded an effect size of 0.82 (95% CI: 0.65–1.04), indicating no statistically significant association between fermented_foods and breast cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 90.83%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
